title: 電脳爆裂！ネオン・ガイアの咆哮
author: 雷電 ゴウ

en.title: Cyber Burst! The Roar of Neon Gaia
en.premise: In the sleepless megacity Neon Gaia, where skyscrapers refuse the night, the souls of its citizens are meticulously archived in the underground Library. When that massive data pool mutates into colossal, bug‑born monsters, they descend to devour the city and the very memories of its people. Standing against them are hot‑blooded pilots who pour their own spirits into steel mechs. With daring combos, thunderous roars, and a soul‑piercing finishing strike, they fight to reclaim lost memories and a burning tomorrow. Now the iron giants roar!

zh.title: 电脑爆裂！霓虹·盖亚的咆哮
zh.premise: 在拒绝夜幕的摩天楼林立的‘不眠之城’霓虹·盖亚，居民的灵魂记录被严密保存在地下图书馆。然而，庞大的数据化作漏洞化身的巨型怪兽，冲击城市，吞噬人们的记忆！迎战的是将灵魂燃烧于钢铁机体的热血飞行员们。合体、咆哮、以及能敲击灵魂的必杀一击！为了夺回失去的记忆与燃烧的明天，钢铁巨神们此刻正怒吼！
